parameters: Hey, catch!\LB\LB(The Innkeeper tosses you a shiny magical-looking gleaming orb.)\LB\LB
We're giving these out to all of our customers.  Enjoy!\LB
\$\V[2] GP, \V[3] SP, \V[4] CP for one night.  Would you like to stay?
\$Sorry, Looks like you don’t have enough money.
Sorry, Looks like you don’t have enough money.
Hey there.  All us in this place have the same genetic abnormality, making us perpetual teenagers no matter how old we get.
It also makes us look like we're twins, with how it gives us the same faces that come with the DNA.  It looks like two of your party
have it too, seeing that a couple of your group have my face and pure white skin just like myself.  Anyways, if you want something
to eat, just say the word - I've always got plenty to pass around here.
Yeah, I know what you're talking about.  It's my face too, and also my twin brother's right here.  We grew up together with it, so we both
know what it's like to see our own face right in front of us turn around and talk to us with our own voice.  We also know what it's like to
always have a teenage body, and always have our bodies heal perfectly, with our white skin that's always perfect, and - Well, you have it
too, so you don't need me to tell you about all the stuff that comes with it either.
Hey what is this place anyways?  Where are we?
You're in testing grounds for something, that's the best way I can describe it.  Our group in this building live and
work here, every day, myself and the others.  Over on the other side is one of my buddies who sells all kinds of things, and
has a HUGE inventory.  My other friend, in the center right over there, runs the inn here, if you can call it that, if you
and your friends happen to want a place to stay for the night.
The beds are upstairs, past our very own in-house House of Many Lives, with a full-time priest.  You still gotta check in
with my buddy on the ground floor right over there if you wanna stay here though.
Hey watch out if you leave and walk around outside.  Past the fence is a lot of wilderness, and there's a lot of guys out there who
also have our genetic quirk as well, but they aren't friendly.  In fact, they'll jump you and take whatever they can get off of your
dead body if they can.  If you and your friends run into any of them, I'd either fight them or run for it, your choice.  If you do
fight them, and win, I'd suggest you go ahead and loot their bodies.  No really, just take their money!
There's really no town or civilization out here, so there's no justice system or government.  It's not like anyone would punish you
for taking their GP.  Of course that's also why they'll try to do the same thing to you guys.
So anyways, wanna bite to eat?
Um, I think I'll look around a little first.  Thanks though, I'll keep it in mind.
Hey no problem.  Look, if you want we can spare a couple of guys who have fighting experience to go with you for a while.
Two of my friends would love a reason to get out a little and go fight - A ninja and a combat mage.
If you're interested in having one or both join you, just talk to me again and I'll bring them down here to talk to you about it.
Hey, it wasn't too bad.  \N[1]'s cool, we had no problems.
Hey \N[1], do you wanna have me sit tight and hang out here, until you want me with you fighting monsters and stuff again?\LB
Yes, Take a break until we need you again.
No, stick with us for now.
Yes, Take a break until we need you again.
Okay, sure.  If you want me again, just talk to my friend here.  (\N[8] points to the Chef.)\LB
I gotta run.  Hey, I'm a farmer too, and I need to catch up on my work here.\LB
(\N[8] leaves your party.  Full of energy, he dashes out the door, outside to tend to the crops.)
No, stick with us for now.
\N[9], How ya doin'?  You do okay with \N[1] and his friends?
\N[1], If you want I can wait here until you want me to travel with you again.  They need me here at the farm anyways.\LB
Or I could stick with you guys for a while longer.
Yes, you can leave until we need you again.
No, please stick with us for now.
Yes, you can leave until we need you again.
Okay, sure.  If you want me again, just talk to my buddy here.  (\N[9] gestures at the Chef.)\LB
Okay, I need to check up on what's been going on here at the farm since I've been out.\LB
(\N[9] leaves your party.  He energetically rushes upstairs and out of sight.)
No, please stick with us for now.
Okay, that's fine.  I'm ready for more adventure as soon as you are.
Hey \N[1], any time you wannna borrow a friend of mine to go out there with you, just ask me when I'm at the counter here.\LB
Any time you borrow one of my friends and want to bring them back, come back in here and talk to me for that, too.
So do you want me to check with my friends and see if they'll go with you guys?
Okay, suit yourself.  You can always change your mind.
(The chef whistles loudly and yells up the stairs like a little kid.)\LB
Hey \N[8]!  Come on down and talk to \N[1]!
(One of the farmers who lives in this place comes rushing down the stairs, energetically making his way over to you.)\LB
Do you want my ninja friend \N[8] to go with you guys for a while?
(\N[8] rushes back upstairs, just as energetically as he did coming down.)
(The chef whistles loudly and yells up the stairs like a little kid.)\LB
Hey \N[9]!  Come on down and talk to \N[1]!
(One of the farmers who lives in this place comes downstairs and heads over to talk to you, looking interested.)\LB
Do you want my combat mage friend \N[9] to go with you guys for a while?
Nice.  I could use a break from the usual.\LB
Okay.  You know how to find me.
